requirements.test_case: Perform goniophotometric RI measurements at all Table 3 angles for red Class IA/IB.

requirements.text: The RI of the retro-reflector shall not be lower than the values specified for the outer illumination angles within the solid angle that has the centre of reference as its apex and is bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Scan RI within the bounded solid angle and confirm no value falls below the outer-angle minima.

requirements.text: Where the Class IA/IB retro-reflector is intended to be installed with its H plane less than 750 mm above the ground, its RI values may be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the declared mounting height and, if below 750 mm, limit downward RI verification to 5°.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the luminous flux reflected by the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour red specified in UN Regulation No. 48. This applies both in case of a red-coloured optical unit and in case of a colourless optical unit behind the red outer lens acting as filter.
requirements.test_case: Measure the x,y chromaticity of the reflected light and compare with the UN R48 red night-time colour boundaries.

requirements.text: Mass-produced retro-reflectors (Class IA/IB, red) shall conform mechanically and geometrically to the approved type; differences shall not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure shape and dimensions of production retro-reflectors and compare them with the approved type drawings and the Annex 5 Class IA/IB limits.

requirements.text: For photometric performance of any mass-produced retro-reflector chosen at random, no measured value (coefficient of luminous intensity) shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the CIL of randomly selected production retro-reflectors at the prescribed angles and check that each value is at least 80 per cent of the prescribed minimum.

requirements.text: Mass-produced retro-reflectors shall comply with the chromaticity coordinates prescribed for red retro-reflected light.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of production samples per the colorimetric test conditions and check that they lie within the red limits.

requirements.text: When the RI of the red retro-reflector (Class IA/IB) is measured at β1 = β2 = 0° and a mirror effect is produced on slightly turning the device, the RI reading shall be taken at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0° and shall meet the prescribed value there.
requirements.test_case: Turn the sample slightly on the goniometer at β1 = β2 = 0° to check for specular reflection; if present, measure RI at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0° and compare with the limit.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector is not marked "TOP", at an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° (or the angle specified in paragraph 5) and an angle of divergence of 20', the minimum RI found on rotating the retro-reflector about its axis of reference shall conform to the value specified in paragraph 5 (for red Class IA/IB: at least 300 mcd/lx).
requirements.test_case: Rotate the unmarked sample through 360° about its reference axis at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°, find the minimum RI and verify it is at least 300 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector is not marked "TOP", the RI at the other angles of illumination and divergence shall be met with the device in the rotation position ε of minimum RI. If the specified values are not attained there, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference by up to ±5° from that position.
requirements.test_case: Perform the complete photometry at the minimum-RI rotation position and, where a value fails, re-measure within ±5° rotation to check compliance.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector is marked "TOP", at an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° (or the angle specified) and an angle of divergence of 20', the RI shall not fall below the prescribed value (for red Class IA/IB: 300 mcd/lx) in any position assumed during rotation of the device by ±5° about its axis of reference.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked sample ±5° about its reference axis at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°, record RI continuously and check it stays at least 300 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: If, at β1 = β2 = 0° and ε = 0°, the RI of the retro-reflector exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, the RI requirements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be met at ε = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at ε = 0° and β1 = β2 = 0°; if it is at least 150 % of the limit, perform all photometric measurements at ε = 0° and compare with Table 3.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the Class IA or IB retro-reflector shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape prescribed for retro-reflectors of Classes IIIA and IIIB (paragraph 2.1.) when observed from a distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the illuminating surface of the retro-reflector from 10 m and confirm its shape cannot be mistaken for a triangle.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector (Class IA, or Class IB where the moisture and dust alternative is not used), whether part of the rear lamp or not and stripped of all removable parts, shall withstand immersion for 10 minutes in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C. The test is done first with the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the water surface. It is then repeated with the device turned through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water. Immediately afterwards the device shall withstand immersion under the same conditions in water at 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Immerse the stripped retro-reflector or lamp unit in a 50 °C ± 5 °C water bath for 10 min in each of the two orientations at the prescribed depths.

requirements.text: After the water immersion test, no water shall have penetrated to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit. If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall be considered to have failed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the reflecting surface of the retro-reflector for water after the immersion sequence.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water, or in case of doubt, the retro-reflector shall still meet the CIL (RI) requirements of paragraph 5.1.4 after the water immersion test. The RI is measured by the method of paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 at an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0°, or if necessary in all positions of Part 1 of Annex 4. The device is first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.test_case: Lightly shake the sample, then measure the CIL at 20' divergence and β1 = β2 = 0° and compare it with the paragraph 5.1.4 limits.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB (not watertight lamp) where the manufacturer requests the moisture and dust test alternative, the retro-reflector (as part of the lamp) shall be exposed to a solid-cone water spray. The spray shall be directed downward at 45° ± 5° to the vertical, with a precipitation rate at the device of 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min, while the device rotates about its vertical axis at 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.
requirements.test_case: Run the water spray cabinet test with the verified precipitation rate, nozzle angle and rotation speed on a lamp sample.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture test alternative, the rear position, stop and reversing functions grouped or reciprocally incorporated with the retro-reflector shall be operated at design voltage during the water spray, in a cycle of 5 min ON and 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Energise the lamp functions at design voltage with a 5 min ON / 55 min OFF timer during the spray test.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture test alternative, the water spray exposure shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min), followed by a 1 h drain period with rotation and spray off.
requirements.test_case: Record the spray duration and the drain period during the test.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture test alternative, the lamp shall be tested with all drain holes and other openings open, and any drain wicks used shall be fitted in the device during the test.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the sample before the test to confirm that openings are open and drain wicks are fitted.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture test alternative, after the drain period no standing pool of water shall have formed in the interior of the device, nor be formable by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: After the 1 h drain period, inspect the lamp interior visually and tap and tilt it to check for pooled water.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture test alternative, the retro-reflector shall be photometrically evaluated after the moisture test. Its RI shall be measured according to Part 1 of Annex 4 after the exterior has been dried.
requirements.test_case: Measure the RI before and after the spray test on a goniophotometer per Annex 4 Part 1 and compare with the required values.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the dust test alternative, the retro-reflector (in the lamp) shall be exposed to fine powdered cement test dust (ASTM C 150-84) in a dust chamber for 5 hours. The dust shall be agitated every 15 min for 2 to 15 s and allowed to settle between agitations.
requirements.test_case: Run the dust chamber exposure with cement dust per ASTM C 150-84 for 5 h at the prescribed agitation intervals.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the dust test alternative, the lamp shall be dust-tested with all drain holes and other openings open, and any drain wicks used shall be fitted in the device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the sample configuration before the dust exposure.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the dust test alternative, after the dust exposure and cleaning of the exterior, the retro-reflector RI shall satisfy paragraph 5.1.4. It is measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 at a divergence angle of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0°, or in all positions of Annex 4 Part 1 paragraphs 1.1 and 1.2 if necessary.
requirements.test_case: Measure the RI at 20' / 0° after the dust exposure and compare with the paragraph 5.1.4 requirements.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be designed so that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: After the saline-mist corrosion test, re-measure the photometric and colorimetric values and compare them with the prescribed limits.

requirements.text: The front surface of the retro-reflector shall resist tarnishing and the protection of its rear face shall resist deterioration, particularly where an essential metal component is liable to be attacked, when tested for corrosion resistance according to ISO 9227:2017.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the front surface and the rear-face protection for tarnishing or deterioration after the ISO 9227 salt-spray exposure.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand exposure to a saline mist for a period of 50 hours. Because it is combined with a lamp, the complete rear lamp is tested, stripped of all removable parts. The 50 hours comprise two 24-hour exposure periods separated by a 2-hour interval during which the sample dries.
requirements.test_case: Expose the lamp, stripped of removable parts, to salt mist for 2 × 24 h with a 2 h drying interval, then evaluate it.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion (e.g. metallised mirror-backed prisms), the device shall withstand a saline mist produced by atomizing, at 35 °C ± 2 °C, a solution of 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Run the salt-mist exposure with a 5 % NaCl solution at 35 ± 2 °C and verify the chamber settings.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the retro-reflector shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the salt-mist test for corrosion that could impair its efficiency.

requirements.text: In case of a mirror-backed (metallised) moulded plastics Class IA/IB retro-reflector with an accessible rear face, the rear face shall withstand the following sequence: brushing with a hard nylon brush, then application for one minute of a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture of Annex 7 Part 1 (70 vol. % n-heptane and 30 vol. % toluol), then brushing again with the same brush once evaporation is complete.
requirements.test_case: Brush the rear face with a hard nylon brush, apply a cloth soaked in 70/30 n-heptane/toluol for 1 min, let it dry and brush again, then proceed to the RI measurement.

requirements.text: In case of a mirror-backed Class IA/IB retro-reflector with an accessible rear face, after the rear-face resistance test and with the whole mirror-backed rear face covered with Indian ink, the coefficient of luminous intensity (RI) shall still satisfy the conditions of paragraph 5.1.4. The check is made per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 at an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0°, or, if necessary, in all positions of Annex 4 Part 1 paragraphs 1.1 and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Cover the tested rear face completely with Indian ink and measure the RI goniometrically at 20' divergence and β1 = β2 = 0°, then compare it with the paragraph 5.1.4 limits for red Class IA/IB.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector, in particular its illuminating surface, shall withstand exposure to a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol applied by light wiping with a soaked cotton cloth (resistance to fuels test).
requirements.test_case: Lightly wipe the outer and illuminating surface of the retro-reflector with a cotton cloth soaked in 70/30 n-heptane/toluol mixture.

requirements.text: About five minutes after application of the n-heptane/toluol test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflector shall show no apparent surface changes on visual inspection, except that slight surface cracks are not objected to.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the wiped surface of the retro-reflector about 5 minutes after wiping for surface changes other than slight cracks.

requirements.text: After the outer surface of the moulded plastics Class IA/IB retro-reflector, in particular its illuminating surface, has been lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil and cleaned after about 5 minutes, its CIL (RI) shall still meet the conditions of paragraph 5.1.4. This is verified at an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0°, or, if necessary, in all positions of Annex 4 Part 1, paragraphs 1.1 and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the illuminating surface with detergent lubricating oil and clean it after 5 min. Then measure the CIL at 20' divergence and β1 = β2 = 0° and compare it with the 5.1.4 limits.

requirements.text: The external projection provisions do not apply to those parts of the rear lamp's external surface (lens, visible housing rim, exposed seal) which, with the vehicle laden and all doors, windows and access lids closed, are at a height of more than 2 m.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the lamp's exposed surfaces on the laden vehicle with all closures shut.

requirements.text: The external projection provisions do not apply to those parts of the rear lamp's external surface which, with the vehicle laden and all doors, windows and access lids closed, are below the floor line.
requirements.test_case: Determine the floor line on the laden vehicle and check which lamp surfaces lie below it.

requirements.text: The external projection provisions do not apply to those parts of the rear lamp's external surface (e.g. recessed lens or housing edges, a concealed seal) which, with the vehicle laden and all closures shut, cannot be contacted by a 100 mm diameter sphere, both in their static condition and in operation.
requirements.test_case: Apply a 100 mm diameter sphere to the lamp area on the vehicle and identify the surfaces it cannot contact.

requirements.text: The external surface formed by the installed rear lamp shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by or brushing against it in a collision.
requirements.test_case: Visually and tactilely inspect the installed lamp's lens, rim and seal for pointed, sharp or injurious projections.

requirements.text: The external surface formed by the installed rear lamp shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp and its junction with the body for outward-directed hooks, edges or gaps that could catch.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp (lens or housing rim/bezel) protrudes 5 mm or more beyond the panel, no protruding part of it shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection per Annex 3 para 2 and check the edge radii with radius gauges.

requirements.text: In case parts of the rear lamp's external surface protrude less than 5 mm but 1.5 mm or more, the 2.5 mm minimum radius does not apply, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection of the edges per Annex 3 and inspect the outward facing angles for blunting.

requirements.text: Parts of the rear lamp's external surface which protrude less than 1.5 mm are exempt from both the 2.5 mm minimum radius and the blunting requirement.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection per Annex 3 para 2 and confirm it is below 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: Protruding parts of the rear lamp's external surface made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 Shore A (e.g. an exposed TPE/silicone seal) may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the Shore A hardness of the exposed seal on the installed lamp and check its edge radii.

requirements.text: When the hardness exemption is claimed, the hardness of the rear lamp part shall be measured with the component as installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Shore A durometer measurement on the part while it is mounted on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where a Shore A hardness measurement of the rear lamp part is impossible, comparable measurements shall be used to evaluate it against the 60 Shore A threshold.
requirements.test_case: Document and perform an equivalent hardness measurement method and compare the result against the 60 Shore A equivalent.

requirements.text: Vehicles approved under UN R26 shall be manufactured to conform to the approved type by meeting the requirements of paragraphs 5 and 6. For the rear combination lamp, this means the exposed outer lens, any visible housing rim and any exposed seal on series-production vehicles must keep the approved external-projection characteristics: no pointed or sharp parts, radius of curvature of at least 2.5 mm, or the hardness of 60 Shore A or less or the small-projection exemptions where they are used.
requirements.test_case: On production samples of the lamp as installed, measure edge radii, projection heights (Annex 3 method) and Shore A hardness, and compare them with the approved type and the limits of paragraph 5.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp protrudes beyond the panel nominal line and is mounted on a convex surface, the dimension of the projection of the rear lamp may be determined either directly or by reference to a drawing of an appropriate section of the lamp in its installed condition.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp's projection directly on the installed vehicle, or check it on the manufacturer's installed-condition section drawing.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp protrudes beyond the panel nominal line and is mounted on a surface other than convex, and its projection cannot be determined by simple measurement, the dimension of the projection of the lamp shall be determined as the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel when the sphere is moved over the lamp in constant contact with it.
requirements.test_case: Move a 100 mm sphere over the installed lamp in constant contact and record the maximum variation of the sphere-centre distance from the panel nominal line.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp (rear position, stop, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector) shall be so fitted that, under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding any vibrations to which it may be subjected, it retains the characteristics prescribed by UN R48 and enables the vehicle to comply with the requirements of UN R48.
requirements.test_case: Vibration test of the lamp on its mounting, then re-measure photometry, colour and orientation against R48 values.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the rear combination lamp to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mounting design and check that the reference axis does not shift after the vibration and handling checks.

requirements.text: The reference axis of each signalling function of the lamp, when fitted to the vehicle, shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the vertical angle of the lamp reference axis relative to the road plane on the installed vehicle.

requirements.text: The reference axis of each signalling function of the lamp, when fitted to the vehicle, shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the horizontal angle of the lamp reference axis relative to the vehicle median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the lamp manufacturer shall be complied with when the lamp is installed.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installation against the manufacturer's fitting instructions.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamp shall be verified with the vehicle unladen, on a flat horizontal surface, in normal condition of use (propulsion system running, movable components in normal position).
requirements.test_case: Measure lamp height and orientation with the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface with the engine running.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the left and right lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral positions of the exterior outlines of the left and right lamps relative to the vehicle centre plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, except for the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the exterior geometry of the left and right lamps for mirror symmetry.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of each function on the left and right lamps.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics.
requirements.test_case: Compare the photometric distributions of each function in the left and right lamps.

requirements.text: In case the lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo may be fitted on the rear of the vehicle, and only vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are permitted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle rear for the number, position and ownership of illuminated logos.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the pair requirements of paragraph 5.5 shall be satisfied as far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Review the asymmetry justification and check symmetry wherever the body shape permits.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify each function individually for colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connection on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of each lamp function shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which it is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and chromaticity of each function with all other functions switched OFF.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp (or another function that can be switched ON together with it), the colour requirements of that other function shall be fulfilled when both the reciprocally incorporated function and the rear position lamp are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop lamp chromaticity with the rear position lamp and stop lamp switched ON simultaneously.

requirements.text: In case a single lamp function (other than the retro-reflector) has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, either the total projected area of the distinct parts in the direction of the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the minimum distance between facing edges of adjacent distinct parts shall not exceed 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Determine the projected apparent surface parts and compute the area ratio or measure the gap between adjacent parts.

requirements.text: In case a function is obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", either the projection of the apparent surfaces of the two lamps in the direction of the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the two apparent surfaces shall not exceed 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projected apparent surfaces of both D lamps and compute the area ratio or the edge gap.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system marked "Y", the system shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1; two or more lamps or separate apparent surfaces within the same lamp body or behind a common outer lens shall not be considered an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Check the Y-system configuration and apply the 60 % / 75 mm check across the interdependent lamps.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface) of each lamp function shall not be intentionally varied while the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Monitor intensity, colour and lit surface over time with the function switched ON.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of a lamp function may vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation complies with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity in each operating state and check it against the R148 limits for the function.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Observe from the front of the vehicle with the red functions switched ON.

requirements.text: There shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of the red lamp functions for an observer moving within Zone 1 (between 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground, bounded laterally by planes at 15° outwards from the vehicle overall width) in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Visual check from Zone 1 at 25 m in front of the vehicle, or CAD sight-line analysis per Annex 4.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the no-red-light-to-the-front requirement is deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of red light emitted to the front, as verified during lamp type approval, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp, taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Measure the red luminous intensity emitted in forward directions by the lamp and confirm it is ≤ 0.25 cd.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamps can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, end-outline and side-marker lamps (if they exist) and the rear registration plate lamp.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lighting switch and verify that rear position lamps switch together with the other listed lamps.

requirements.text: The simultaneous switching requirement does not apply while the rear position lamps are switched ON as parking lamps, while daytime running lamps are switched ON, or while the front position lamp function is substituted under paragraph 5.12.1.
requirements.test_case: Check the switching logic in parking-lamp and DRL modes.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources of the system shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Switch the function and verify that all interdependent lamps light and extinguish together.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector shall not be concealable.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation for any concealment device covering the lamp.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure rear position lamp chromaticity against the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop lamp chromaticity against the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure reversing lamp chromaticity through the clear window against the white boundaries.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the retro-reflected colour against the red boundaries.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, it shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check position, visibility, colour and photometry with the movable component in each fixed position.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp function on a movable component is obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Verify that at least one D lamp complies at all fixed positions of the movable component.

requirements.text: In case additional rear position lamps or retro-reflectors are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Open the movable component and check the additional lamps for position, visibility and photometry.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is installed on a movable component, it shall not cause undue discomfort to road users when the movable component is in a position other than the normal position of use.
requirements.test_case: Assess glare and light direction with the movable component open.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is installed on a movable component, the lamp shall always return to the position specified by the manufacturer when the movable component is in the normal position of use.
requirements.test_case: Cycle the movable component repeatedly and measure the lamp position and orientation after each closure.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp and rear retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component in any fixed position different from the normal position of use.
requirements.test_case: Measure the hidden fraction of the apparent surface in each fixed position of the movable components.

requirements.text: If the 50 per cent hiding limit is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the rear position lamp shall be switched ON when more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface is hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Open the movable component and verify that compliant additional lamps switch ON.

requirements.text: Each light-emitting function of the lamp (other than the retro-reflector) shall be operable when installed; a lamp that cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse is deemed not to be present.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that each function operates with its wiring and fuse installed.

requirements.text: A temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function is allowed, provided that the replacement function is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the failed function and the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a rear position lamp failure and compare the colour, intensity and position of the substitute function.

requirements.text: During a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard shall indicate the occurrence of the temporary replacement and the need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate the failure and verify that the dashboard tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp (category R2) and stop lamp (category S2) have variable luminous intensity control, the intensities of all such combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated lamps shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensities of both functions across the variation range and compare their proportional change.

requirements.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, the prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the stop lamp and the rear position lamp shall be maintained over the entire intensity range, including during variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Record the stop/position intensity ratio continuously during intensity transitions.

requirements.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, an increase or decrease of luminous intensity within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulations is allowed only in relation to ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds or contamination of the light-emitting surface.
requirements.test_case: Review the control triggers and measure intensities against the R148 R2/S2 limits.

requirements.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, a decrease of luminous intensity within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulations is allowed while the vehicle speed is ≤ 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is ≤ 20 m, and an already activated decrease may remain active while the vehicle speed is ≤ 50 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Drive and following-distance tests verifying the activation and deactivation thresholds of the intensity reduction.

requirements.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
requirements.test_case: Record intensity over time during transitions and check for step changes.

requirements.text: In case the stop lamp or rear position lamp was type approved with a special power supply, in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, the voltage supplied at its terminals in the vehicle constant-voltage operating condition shall not exceed the voltage specified for that function as approved.
requirements.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage on the vehicle in constant-voltage operation and compare it with the approval voltage.

requirements.text: In all other cases, for a 12 V system the voltage at the terminals of the stop lamp and rear position lamp shall not exceed 13.5 V by more than 3 per cent; the means of controlling the maximum voltage may be located within the lamp body.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp terminal voltage with the vehicle in constant-voltage operation.

requirements.text: In all other cases, for a 24 V system the voltage at the terminals of the stop lamp and rear position lamp shall not exceed 28 V by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp terminal voltage with the vehicle in constant-voltage operation.

requirements.text: The terminal voltage limits of paragraphs 5.27.1 and 5.27.2 do not apply in case the lamp includes an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control as part of the device.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp design and approval documents for integrated control gear.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle inside the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of each lamp function observed from infinity, except obstacles already present when the lamp was type approved.
requirements.test_case: Check the geometric visibility angles on the vehicle or in a CAD sight-line study.

requirements.text: If any part of the apparent surface of the installed lamp is hidden by other parts of the vehicle, the part of the lamp not hidden shall still conform to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry of the lamp with the masking vehicle parts in place, or with equivalent screening.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is less than 750 mm above the ground (measured from the H plane) and the vertical geometric visibility angle below the horizontal may be reduced to 5°, the photometric field of measurement of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height and verify photometry down to 5° below horizontal.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Verify geometric visibility with all interdependent lamps lit.

requirements.text: The LED modules of the lamp need not be replaceable, provided this is stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
requirements.test_case: Check the R148 communication sheet for the non-replaceable LED module statement.

requirements.text: The rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions shall be type approved according to UN R148, and the rear retro-reflector according to UN R150, when installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the approval markings on the lamp and the corresponding approval certificates.

requirements.text: In case the lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN R148.
requirements.test_case: Check that the R148 approval covers the lamp with its logo.

requirements.text: On M1 vehicles one reversing lamp device is mandatory and a second reversing lamp device is optional.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and count the reversing lamps fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23 or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the R148 (or R23) approval mark and certificate of the reversing lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mounted not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reversing lamp apparent surface height above ground on the vehicle in the prescribed load condition.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be installed at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp installed at the rear shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle α of 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle or by CAD that the reversing lamp apparent surface is visible over 15° up and 5° down.

requirements.text: If only one reversing lamp is fitted, the reversing lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle β of 45° to the right and to the left.
requirements.test_case: Verify visibility of the apparent surface over 45° left and right by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: If two reversing lamps are fitted, each reversing lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle β of 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify visibility of each apparent surface over 45° outwards and 30° inwards by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and the propulsion system start/stop device is in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: engage reverse with propulsion possible and confirm the lamp lights only under these conditions.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the propulsion system cannot operate.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: disengage reverse or switch off propulsion and confirm the lamp is off.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check R148 requirements and verify the failure tell-tale operates by simulating LED failure.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of category S1 or S2 are mandatory on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for presence of S1/S2 stop lamps.

requirements.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be fitted, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7 or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the number of stop lamps and their R148/R7 approval marks.

requirements.text: For M1 vehicles, the point of the apparent surface of an S1 or S2 stop lamp in the direction of the reference axis farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outer edge of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall be mounted not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the stop lamp apparent surface height above ground.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; for stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify horizontal visibility of the stop lamp apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the stop lamp apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the service brake and confirm all stop lamps light simultaneously.

requirements.text: The stop lamps need not function if the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
requirements.test_case: Functional check of stop lamp with propulsion system off (optional behaviour).

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Simulate LED failure and verify the failure tell-tale if required by R148.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for presence of rear position lamps.

requirements.text: Two rear position lamps shall be fitted, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7 or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the number of rear position lamps and their approval marks.

requirements.text: The point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outer edge of the rear position lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be mounted not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the rear position lamp apparent surface height above ground.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify horizontal visibility of the apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: For M1 vehicles, as an alternative at the manufacturer's discretion and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed, the rear position lamp horizontal geometric visibility may be 45° outwards to 45° inwards, with the inward angle reducible to 20° under the H plane where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: If the alternative is used, confirm a rear side-marker lamp is fitted and verify 45°/45° horizontal visibility.

requirements.text: In case of the alternative visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2, the rear position lamp shall have a vertical visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, with the downward angle reducible to 5° where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: In case of the alternative visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2, to be considered visible the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm², excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
requirements.test_case: Measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface at the boundary angles, excluding the retro-reflector area, and confirm ≥ 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11, so that the front and rear position lamps (and end-outline, side-marker and rear registration plate lamps if fitted) can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Operate the position lamp switch and confirm simultaneous switching of all related lamps.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps is mandatory and shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch on position lamps and verify the combined tell-tale lights.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Simulate LED failure and verify the failure tell-tale if required by R148.

requirements.text: Non-triangular rear retro-reflectors are mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for presence of rear retro-reflectors.

requirements.text: Two rear retro-reflectors shall be fitted, type-approved according to the requirements for Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3 or the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check the retro-reflector R150 (or R3) Class IA/IB approval mark.

requirements.text: The point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outer edge of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the vehicle outer edge.

requirements.text: As the rear retro-reflector is grouped with rear lamps, it shall be mounted not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground (1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,200 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure the retro-reflector illuminating surface height above ground.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify horizontal visibility of the retro-reflector illuminating surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 10° above and below the horizontal; where it is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the retro-reflector illuminating surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector may have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp layout for overlapping retro-reflector and lamp surfaces (permitted).

requirements.text: In case the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, it shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all stop lamps fitted.
requirements.test_case: Trigger emergency braking above 50 km/h and confirm all stop lamps operate simultaneously.

requirements.text: In case the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, all lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Measure the flash frequency and phase of the stop lamps during emergency stop signal operation.

requirements.text: In case the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, the emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Operate the emergency stop signal with other lamps on/off and confirm independent operation.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle test: verify activation only above 50 km/h with emergency braking logic signal present.

requirements.text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the approved type by meeting the requirements of paragraphs 5 and 6; series-production rear combination lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector) shall therefore keep the installation-relevant characteristics of the approved type: position, orientation, geometric visibility, colour and luminous intensity.
requirements.test_case: Take series-production vehicles or lamps and re-check lamp position, orientation, geometric visibility, colour and on-axis intensity per Annex 9 against the type-approval results.

requirements.text: In case the non-textured outer lens is excluded when determining the apparent surface of one function (F2) of the rear combination lamp, and '7b' is taken as the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2, the adjacent function F1 shall not be transparent to F2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect drawings and the sample with F2 lit, and check that no F2 light passes through the F1 area and that the declared apparent surface matches the Annex 3 Part 7 example.
